title: Passenger Seat Traffic Control
north_star: A public identity mirror where ordinary desi couple behavior becomes concrete, funny evidence of love.
human_truth: Some couples are not one calm driver and one silent passenger. They are one steering wheel and two opinions.
emotional_arc: public contradiction -> road-trip receipts -> physical comic proof -> active co-pilot response -> taggable tenderness
source_story_summary: Aachu becomes passenger-seat mission control: Maps says left in 300 meters, she says LEFT-LEFT-LEFT now; her foot finds the invisible brake; the AC has a committee; the playlist gets vetoed. Zuv does not make her the problem. He drives safely, stays amused, and asks, 'Captain, next?'
visual_style: warm hand-drawn desi storybook illustrated car/cab carousel, behavior-first, airy, funny, non-glossy
target_voice: @a.storyof.two: funny, affectionate, concrete, Hinglish-friendly, sendable, not generic soft romance

golden_theme_contract.rule: Start with a public contradiction, prove it with concrete Aachu/Nancho behavior, make Zuv/Himanshu actively choose the shared bit, and land a sendable thesis.
hard_fail_if: The joke reads as nagging wife / helpless husband.
The visuals imply unsafe driving, panic, anger, or actual danger.
Zuv is passive, obedient, or only tolerating her.
The deck becomes a pretty car romance instead of behavior receipts.
The final line is generic and not taggable.

story_selling_decision.selector_verdict: The route passes because the passenger-seat behavior is instantly recognizable, receipt-dense, drawable, and taggable when repaired away from nagging/helpless framing.

concept_diagnosis.public_hook: He didn't marry a quiet passenger. He married mission control.
concept_diagnosis.reader_identity_mirror: This is us in every car/cab: one person drives, the other supervises the universe.
concept_diagnosis.emotional_obstacle: Her commentary could be read as control unless he turns it into co-pilot language.
concept_diagnosis.aachu_proof: LEFT-LEFT-LEFT, invisible brake, AC committee, playlist veto.
concept_diagnosis.zuv_active_role: He drives safely, stays amused, and asks 'Captain, next?'
concept_diagnosis.bridge: The joke turns from passenger-seat chaos into chosen partnership.
concept_diagnosis.earned_ending: Maybe love is one steering wheel and two opinions.
concept_diagnosis.send_save_reason: Viewers can tag the passenger-seat supervisor or the calm driver.
